definition: Self-established — not dependent on anything else for its existence or nature. Śiva is svapratiṣṭha: established in his own nature, unmoved by the world-waves that arise within him.

sources.claim: svasvarūpaviśrāntyavasthitaḥ — established in his own nature, like an ocean unmoved by world-waves

translations.note: 'Self-established' captures the ontological independence; 'self-sufficient' implies lack; 'self-grounded' is acceptable.
